label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.3… supports Whatever grounds a potency in a respect is…
note: Q.3 a.1 co. says 'quod est in potentia, non reducitur in actum nisi per ens actu': what reduces a potency to act is in act. The premise says it of whatever grounds a potency, including a potency never reduced; that extension to grounding and to idle potency is the analyst's.
